name: Operation/implementation of Vidhik Seva Rath
benefit:
- Under the public awareness programme, the mobile van of the State Legal Services Authority, &quot;Vidhik Seva Rath&quot;, is sent to visit every urban area and remote rural areas of two to three districts every month and various welfare schemes run by the central and state government are shown through films.

_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. All residents of the areas visited by the van can benefit from these programs. The team members assigned to the tour inform the public about the schemes using a projector installed in the "Vidhik Seva Rath".
